purpose: Define which AI-OS context paths are routine semantic memory, review-gated semantic candidates, deep-search-only material, or excluded from memory indexing.

routine_semantic.description: Small, curated memory sources indexed by the regular MemSearch maintenance path.

selective_semantic_candidates.description: Durable references that can be proposed for semantic indexing after review, but are not routine hot memory.

deep_search_only.description: Useful source material that should stay out of routine semantic indexing unless a report proposes a curated summary or reference promotion.

excluded.description: Files and folders that should never be treated as memory sources.

promotion_rules.hot_memory: Only distill stable, currently useful facts into MEMORY.md. Keep details in dated logs or reference files.
promotion_rules.reference: Promote durable client knowledge into context/reference/ after review. Preserve source path and date in the promoted file.
promotion_rules.inbox: Inbox files are intake material. They stay deep-search-only until a promotion report is reviewed.
promotion_rules.skills: External skill material goes to skills-library/backlog/ and follows backlog -> triage -> review -> live.
promotion_rules.infrastructure: Tooling or database changes require a tested prototype and explicit approval before becoming AI-OS infrastructure.
